overview.description: The VegaShares Space & AI ETF (XSPC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in SpaceX and other companies involved in the commercial space ecosystem, including launch services, satellite communications, infrastructure providers, and related technologies. The fund aims for capital growth. XSPC was launched on Jun 16, 2026 and is issued by Vegashares.
